board_file.description: Backlog Markdown path, relative to this config file.

csv_file.description: Intermediate import CSV path, relative to this config file.

types.description: Work-item type names for the three backlog levels.

states.description: Workflow state names. 'done' is the terminal state close-children cascades onto child Tasks (Basic: 'Done'; Agile/CMMI: 'Closed'/'Resolved').

epic_heading_regex.description: Regex matching an Epic heading on the stripped line; capture group 1 is the title.

stop_headings.description: Line prefixes that mark the end of the backlog body.

pat_env.description: Environment variable the Personal Access Token is read from.

pat_file.description: Token file checked if the env var is unset. Must be gitignored.

task_title_max.description: Maximum Task title length; bullets are truncated to this.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for idempotent requests.

team.description: Team whose sprint view the iterations are added to. Null auto-detects the '<Project> Team' default.

iterations.description: Sprints for the 'sprints' command. Each entry creates an iteration node and assigns the listed Issue codes (+ their child Tasks) to it.

items.description: Issue codes assigned to this sprint, e.g. ['PROJ-101']. If a code is listed in two sprints the earliest wins.

assignees.description: Owners for the 'assign' command. Each key is an ADO identity (uniqueName/email, or a display name the org resolves); each value lists the Issue codes that identity owns. The identity is set as System.AssignedTo on each Issue and cascaded to its child Tasks. If a code appears under two identities the first listed wins.
